# Timeless Practice — jacklesser.me

> Jack Lesser distills timeless long-form podcasts, speeches, and books into visual takeaway pages and reflection episodes — organized around three pillars: performance, leverage, and inner work.

Jack Lesser leads programming at Bitcoin Park, teaches yoga and breathwork, and writes about freedom technology (Bitcoin, sovereign AI, privacy) and freedom from technology (breath, movement, presence). Each episode page below distills one long-form conversation or speech into its key takeaways, alongside a video reflection and a companion essay on Substack.

## Episodes

- [Naval Ravikant x Joe Rogan](https://jacklesser.me/naval-podcast.html): Wealth, happiness, and leverage — the single-player game, from Joe Rogan Experience #1309.
- [Dr. K x Andre Duqum](https://jacklesser.me/dr-k-podcast.html): Eastern wisdom meets neuroscience — knowledge vs understanding, attention, ego, and dharma.
- [David Goggins x Chris Williamson](https://jacklesser.me/goggins-podcast.html): Never Finished — capping success, the one-second decision, and the inner voice.
- [Acquired: Hermès](https://jacklesser.me/hermes-acquired.html): How a 187-year-old harness maker became the crown jewel of luxury through craftsmanship and scarcity.
- [Elizabeth Gilbert x Tim Ferriss](https://jacklesser.me/gilbert-podcast.html): No cherished outcome — releasing the ego-driven result, and why the most relaxed person in the room wins.
- [Kobe Bryant x Jay Shetty](https://jacklesser.me/kobe-podcast.html): Strategy, obsession, and the long game — the Mamba Mentality as a practice.
- [This Is Water — David Foster Wallace](https://jacklesser.me/this-is-water.html): The Kenyon 2005 commencement — the two fish, main character syndrome, and the choice of what to worship.
- [Ben Francis x Chris Williamson](https://jacklesser.me/ben-francis-podcast.html): The Gymshark founder on quiet operators, the long game, and ambitions for the business over ambitions for yourself.
- [Make Your Bed — Admiral William H. McRaven](https://jacklesser.me/make-your-bed.html): Ten lessons from Navy SEAL training — start with a task completed, and never, ever ring the bell.

## Pillars

- [Freedom Tech](https://jacklesser.me/freedom-tech): Bitcoin, sovereign AI, and privacy — technology that expands individual freedom.
- [Freedom from Tech](https://jacklesser.me/freedom-from-tech): Breathwork, yoga, and presence — practices for coming back to yourself.
- [Connect](https://jacklesser.me/connect): Where to find Jack.

## Elsewhere

- [Substack — Timeless Practice](https://satflow.substack.com): Long-form companion essays for each episode.
